summary: Retrieve all markups for a proposal

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

items.description: Represents a markup (adjustment) applied to a proposal.

id.description: The unique identifier of the markup. Returned by GET Estimate Summary in markups; use as markup_id on markup endpoints.

name.description: The display name of the markup.

value.description: The numeric value of the markup (percentage or lump sum amount).

value_type.description: The type of the markup value.

stage.description: The calculation stage of the markup.

compound_all.description: Whether this markup compounds with all preceding markups in the same stage.

compound_with.description: The IDs of specific markups this markup compounds with.

tax_mapping.description: The tax mapping category for this markup.

application_criteria.description: The flat list of conditions controlling which line items this markup applies to. Conditions are combined with logical AND.
